title: ObjectUserBody: the outputVariableUserFunction provides any output variable the body does not compute itself
author: Claude-JG
description: The outputVariableUserFunction is not limited to UserType0-3; with IfThenElse on outputVariableType a symbolic function provides as many output variables as needed, so beam outputs (strain, curvature, force, torque), energy and accelerations are possible.
releaseNotes: The outputVariableUserFunction of ObjectUserBody provides every output variable the body does not compute itself - strains, curvatures, stresses, forces, torques, potential energy, accelerations, directors and the user types; it returns an empty list for a type it does not provide (revision2026c step RG7.12.4)
